supporting_observations.claim: The PowerShell execution visible in the records occurred at 13:44:39 UTC, after the reported approximate time. It ran as omar.haddad and invoked the inventory-listed patch script from \\FILE-HD-01\IT\Deploy-Patches.ps1.
Immediately beforehand, WS-MLOPEZ-01 recorded a network logon for omar.haddad from the workstation identified as WS-OHADDAD-01; the PowerShell process used that logon ID.

The PowerShell process contacted the explicit proxy for a Windows Update download, then launched wusa.exe to install a Windows 11 update. This is consistent with the stated patching practice, though the script's contents are not shown.

At 13:32:09, taskhostw.exe on WS-MLOPEZ-01 generated an explicit-credentials event naming svc-bkp and PROXY-HD-01. The inventory places svc-bkp on FILE-HD-01, so this credential event on Maria's workstation is unexplained by the supplied context; the event alone does not establish successful authentication.
At 14:11:00, Google Drive File Stream started under maria.lopez. The supplied inventory does not list Google Drive as approved, but these records do not show that it synchronized or uploaded files.

The records show the PowerShell command line and subsequent patch activity, but not the contents, integrity, or source history of Deploy-Patches.ps1.
The explicit-credentials event does not by itself show whether svc-bkp authentication to the proxy succeeded or what network activity followed.
The supplied records do not show whether Google Drive File Stream accessed or transferred files.
